headline: Ransomware Hits Vanderbilt as Phishing Volume Soars
thesis: A claimed Vanderbilt ransomware breach and record phishing counts put security at the center, while districts rewrite AI-use policies and the Ed-Fi Summit wraps up.
summary: Inside Higher Ed reports that a ransomware group claims it hacked Vanderbilt University, as THE Journal notes Microsoft counted 7.3 billion phishing threats in Q3 2026 and KnowBe4 sees spear-phishing up 41%. On the K-12 side, EdTech Magazine covers writing and updating AI-use policies and a Hanover report finding students are told when, but not how, to use AI. Inside Higher Ed also tracks the slow rise of three-year degrees, and the Ed-Fi Alliance Summit closes today in Nashville.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · NOVEMBER 11, 2026 · Built from search results only; direct site fetches were blocked in this environment, so some sources show recent or evergreen items rather than items dated today.

themes.title: Degrees & Pathways
